Row.Text: A gaunt man in a black top hat and suit, with a dark beard but no mustache, gestures with one hand against a red background.

A tall, slender man with a long, gaunt face, prominent cheekbones, a strong jaw, and deep-set dark eyes under heavy brows gazes forward. He has dark, slightly disheveled hair and a trimmed dark beard that covers his jawline and chin, but no mustache. His mouth is closed in a straight line. He wears a tall, black top hat. His clothing consists of a dark, textured frock coat over a black vest with small, dark buttons. A high-collared white shirt is visible at his neck, fastened with a dusky-rose colored bowtie. A gold watch chain with a small fob hangs from a vest pocket. He is shown from the waist up, angled slightly to his left. He raises his right hand in front of his chest, index finger slightly extended as if to emphasize a point, while his left arm is held behind his back. The background is a solid, deep crimson red, overlaid with the faint, darker outlines of a world map. The lighting is dramatic, coming from the front right, casting the left side of his face and body in deep shadow and highlighting the textures of his skin and clothing. The color palette is muted, consisting mainly of black, grey, white, and the deep red of the background.
A young man with light brown skin, long brown hair, and wide green eyes smiles broadly against a dark blue, abstract background.

The portrait features a young man with light brown skin and long, wavy, light brown hair that cascades over his shoulders. His face is round, with large, wide-open green eyes. He has a very wide, open-mouthed smile that reveals a full set of prominent white teeth. His light brown eyebrows are arched high. The visible part of his torso, just below the neck, is a reddish-brown color. He is shown from the chest up, facing directly forward with his head slightly tilted to the right. The figure is framed within a dark circular border. The background is a dark, mottled blue with abstract, blurry shapes. The lighting is even and frontal, illuminating his face clearly.
A carved wooden bust of a bearded man wearing a turban, set against a dark, circular background.

A highly detailed bust of a man, rendered as if carved from a single piece of light brown wood. The man has deep-set eyes under a heavily furrowed brow, a prominent, straight nose, and high cheekbones. His lips are mostly hidden by a thick mustache that flows into a full beard. He wears a soft, rounded, turban-like head covering with carved folds. The bust is presented within a black circular frame, set against a dim, dark gray map of Europe and the Mediterranean. The color palette consists of the monochromatic browns of the wood and the dark grays of the background. Strong lighting from the upper right casts deep shadows, emphasizing the sharp angles of the face and the texture of the wood grain.
A heavy-set, dark-skinned woman with a gold headband and ornate gold jewelry smiles softly.

A heavy-set, dark-skinned woman with a round face is depicted from the chest up. Her short, dark, tightly curled hair frames her face. She has full cheeks, a slight double chin, a wide nose, full lips, and small, dark eyes, and she offers a gentle, subtle smile. A prominent gold headband wraps around her forehead, featuring a circular gold emblem with a red, downward-pointing triangular gem at its center. Long, intricate gold earrings with multiple rectangular and triangular hanging elements are visible below her ears. A broad, decorative gold collar-like necklace covers her upper chest, adorned with geometric patterns and small red circular gems. Gold shoulder armor or garment pieces are visible on her shoulders. She is facing directly forward with a slight tilt of her head. The figure is framed within a black-bordered circle, set against a dark, mottled green background that appears abstract. The portrait uses a palette of warm golds and reds contrasting with her dark skin tone and the deep green background. Lighting is soft and even, illuminating her face and the reflective gold ornaments.
A bare-chested man with a large orange mustache and blue tattoos holds a spear and shield against a red background.

A muscular man with light skin and bright red-orange hair is shown from the chest up. His hair is styled with a long, thick braid falling over his right shoulder, and he has a large, bushy mustache that droops past his chin. His chest, shoulders, and arms are covered in dark blue, abstract geometric tattoos, including swirls and bands. Around his neck is a thick, twisted rope-like collar. He is bare-chested. He holds a tall spear with a leaf-shaped blade in one hand and a large, round wooden shield in the other. The shield is decorated with blue and gold spiral patterns. The figure is lit from the front, set against a dark, stylized red map of the world.
A red-bearded king in gleaming plate armor, wearing a crown and holding a golden mace, stands before a dark world map.

A fair-skinned man with blue eyes and a full, bright red beard and mustache gazes forward. He wears a golden crown with red velvet and jewels. He is clad in a full suit of polished, silver-colored plate armor, with chainmail visible at the joints. A thick red collar is fastened with a gold clasp at his throat. In his gauntleted right hand, he holds a wooden staff topped with an ornate golden mace. The background is a dark gray, textured wall featuring a faint, embossed world map. The figure is lit from the front, creating bright highlights on the metal armor against the muted background.
A man with a full grey beard wears a flat-topped golden crown and a steel plate cuirass over a purple tunic.

A pale-skinned man with grey hair, a full grey beard, and a thick mustache gazes directly forward. His grey eyes are framed by heavy brows. On his head is a flat-topped golden crown adorned with red and blue jewels. He wears a steel cuirass made of riveted square plates over a long-sleeved purple tunic with an embossed, swirling pattern. Layered steel pauldrons protect his shoulders. A heavy gold chain around his neck holds a large pendant: a square blue gem set within a golden, cross-shaped frame. He is shown from the chest up, his right hand partially raised in a loose fist. The background is a solid, dark purple with a faint world map pattern. The lighting is focused on his face and armor from the front.
A woman in a dark, high-collared dress raises a champagne flute, standing before a stylized world map.

A woman with pale skin, dark brown hair, and large blue eyes with heavy lids looks toward the viewer with a slight smile. Her dark hair is parted in the middle and pulled back under a brown, crescent-shaped headdress studded with gold ornaments. She wears a black, high-waisted gown with puffed shoulders and a fitted bodice. A stiff, white, ruffled collar encircles her neck. The bodice is decorated with four white, cross-shaped embroideries and a central gold and pearl brooch. A thin gold chain drapes around her waist as a belt, and the long sleeves end in matching white ruffled cuffs. She holds a tall, slender champagne flute filled with a bubbling, golden beverage in her right hand, extending it slightly forward. The background is a solid dark teal, overlaid with the faint, incised outlines of a world map. The color palette is dominated by dark teal and black, with accents of white and gold. Soft light illuminates her from the front and left.
A woman in an ornate white and gold masquerade mask and a feathered headdress smiles against a starry night sky.

A fair-skinned woman with blue eyes and a slight smile looks forward. She wears an ornate white and gold filigree mask that covers the top half of her face, adorned with a green gem and a large plume of reddish-orange feathers on one side. Her brown hair is styled in an intricate updo held by golden bands. She wears a burnt-orange gown with a high, white, pleated ruff collar. A stiff, white bodice with a grid of gold bands covers her chest. Around her neck and draped at her waist are strings of pale, spherical beads. In the background is a garden at night, with a classical white-columned gazebo and tall, dark trees under a deep blue, starry sky. The lighting is focused on the woman, making her stand out from the dark surroundings.
A bare-chested man with a dark mustache smiles, wearing a large blue turban with a red jewel and an ornate gold collar.

A man with medium-brown skin, a muscular build, and a thin, dark mustache is shown from the waist up. He has long dark hair falling over his shoulders, dark eyes, and an open-mouthed smile. He wears a large, pleated blue turban with a central gold ornament holding a teardrop-shaped red jewel. Around his neck is a wide, ornate gold collar made of several stacked plates detailed with red stones. His chest is bare, with an orange, patterned cloth draped over his right shoulder. A wide blue and gold belt with a large, square blue gemstone buckle sits at his waist above dark bottoms. He wears matching gold armbands on his biceps and wide, studded reddish-brown cuffs with red beads on his wrists. He stands facing forward with his body slightly angled, head tilted, and arms relaxed at his sides. The background is a dark gray, textured surface with the faint, embossed outline of a world map. The figure is lit warmly from the front, highlighting his features and ornaments.
A bust of a crowned man with a long mustache and beard, carved entirely from light brown wood with a visible grain.

This portrait is a wood carving of a man from the chest up. His face has deep-set eyes under heavy brows, a long nose, and prominent cheekbones. He has a very large, thick mustache that droops down past his mouth and curls up at the ends, as well as a long, full beard. His long hair flows back behind his ears. Upon his head is a large, thick crown with a flat top. The entire figure is rendered in light brown wood, with the grain visible across all surfaces. The carving is lit from the upper left, casting deep shadows that define its features. The bust is set against a dark grey, textured background with faint lines like an old map, and the entire image is framed by a black circle.
A woman with a large golden headdress and dramatic eye makeup smiles slightly, resting her chin on her hand.

A woman with brown skin, dark brown eyes, and dark hair cut in short, straight bangs looks directly forward with a slight smile. She wears heavy, winged black eyeliner and purple eyeshadow. A large, ornate golden headdress covers the back and top of her head. Around her neck is a wide, circular collar in blue, gold, and red, featuring a large purple gemstone at the center. Her light-colored, pleated dress has a V-neck and a decorative element on the chest resembling brown wings. She wears armbands with red and white geometric patterns, thick gold bracelets on both wrists, and a coiled gold snake bracelet on her left arm. Her arms are crossed, with her right index finger touching her chin. The background is a dark, purplish-brown wall with the faint outlines of a world map. The figure is lit from the front and left, casting soft shadows.
A woman with a golden headdress and elaborate makeup gazes forward, a moonlit river with pyramids in the distance behind her.

A woman with light brown skin is shown from the waist up. She has dark eyes accented with heavy black liner and bright purple eyeshadow, a slight smile on her lips, and a small mole above the right side of her mouth. Her black hair is styled with straight bangs and thick, tubular curls on the sides, bound by gold rings. She wears an elaborate gold headdress with red and turquoise accents, and large, dangling gold earrings. Her sleeveless, form-fitting dress is dark brown, decorated with gold trim around the neckline and crisscrossing bands at the waist. A wide turquoise and red armband encircles her right bicep. The figure stands against a black background, beside a wide, framed view of a nighttime landscape. This scene depicts a wide river reflecting the moonlight, with several wooden boats moored near a stone dock. The far shore is lined with palm trees, and in the distance, three large pyramids are silhouetted against a dark, blue-green sky. The lighting on the woman is warm and from the front, while the background scene is bathed in cool, silvery moonlight.
A stylized bust of a man carved from light brown wood with sharp, angular features, set against a faded map background.

This portrait depicts a bust of a man carved entirely from a light brown, grained wood. His face is long and angular, with high cheekbones, a sharp, pointed nose, and deep creases on his forehead. His thick eyebrows are angled down over wide, staring eyes. He has a pointed goatee and a thin mustache. His hair is swept back from his face in carved, linear textures. He wears a heavy cloak with a thick, rolled collar, fastened at the shoulders by two large, flat, circular brooches. The figure is lit from the front, highlighting the sharp planes of his face and the wooden grain. He is positioned against a background showing a stylized, faded map of a coastline in muted shades of grey-blue.
A fair-skinned man with dark hair and beard, wearing a gold headband with a central blue jewel, looks forward against a dark background.

The portrait features a fair-skinned man, shown from the chest up, with a thick head of dark, wavy hair reaching his shoulders and a full, dark beard and mustache. His prominent eyebrows are dark and thick, drawn slightly together. He has green eyes and a straight nose. Across his forehead is a wide, ornate gold headband, richly patterned, with a prominent dark blue, possibly sapphire, jewel in the center and smaller dark blue accents along its length. He wears clothing that appears to be a dark purple or blue collar beneath a tan or brown garment visible around his neck and shoulders. The man's head is slightly tilted, and his gaze is directed forward and slightly upward. The background is dark and abstract, with faint, lighter, map-like contours or geographical lines barely visible behind his head. The lighting is direct, illuminating his face and the gold headband, casting subtle shadows under his chin and nose. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by dark browns and gold, with accents of dark blue and purple.
A mosaic depicts a man with a dark beard and yellow head covering, looking right, with a reddish-brown spear visible behind him.

The portrait is a mosaic depicting a man from the chest up, facing forward but with his head turned sharply to look right. He has light brown skin, dark brown hair styled in short, spiky locks that emerge from under a voluminous yellow head covering. He has a thick, dark brown beard and mustache that frames his mouth, which is slightly open. His eyes are wide with dark pupils and white sclera. The yellow head covering wraps around his head and neck, with folds and a lighter yellow accent line, secured by a dark brown and light brown clasp at the throat. He wears a brown cloak or garment with details in reddish-brown and black lines, and a wide, lighter-colored band or sash crosses his chest diagonally. Behind his right shoulder, a reddish-brown diagonal spear or staff is visible against a uniform light beige mosaic background. The overall color palette is earthy, featuring shades of brown, yellow, beige, and reddish-brown.
A woman in a magenta dress and gold jewelry stands with a hand on her hip before a dark blue world map.

A woman with medium-brown skin and dark brown hair pulled back into an updo by a thin gold headband looks forward with a slight, asymmetrical smile. She has dark, thick eyebrows and large brown eyes. She wears a sleeveless, magenta dress with a cowl neckline, held at the shoulders by gold clasps set with blue stones. A pale blue sash is wrapped twice around her waist and tied in a knot. She is adorned with gold jewelry: large hoop earrings, a wide geometric necklace, and thick cuffs on both wrists and her upper left arm, each set with blue stones. She stands turned slightly, with her right hand placed on her hip. Behind her is a textured, dark blue wall featuring a faintly embossed, stylized map of the world. A warm light illuminates her from the front right, creating soft shadows.
A blonde woman wearing a crown of pink roses holds a golden chalice against a red map background.

A light-skinned woman with blue eyes and a slight smile looks forward. Her blonde hair is styled in two thick braids, coiled over her ears and topped with a large wreath of pink roses. She wears a long-sleeved gown with a crimson body and light gray-blue sleeves. The wide, circular neckline is trimmed with a gold band inlaid with alternating blue and green gems. The wide cuffs of her sleeves are decorated with an intricate gold and blue pattern. Around her waist is a gold belt made of linked circular medallions. She holds a small, ornate golden chalice with both hands. The chalice is decorated with blue gems around its cup. The background is a textured, dark red wall featuring a faint, embossed outline of a world map. The lighting is soft, illuminating the woman from the front.
A smiling blonde woman in a gold crown and medieval dress gestures with one hand while holding a golden goblet in the other.

A young woman with fair skin, long blonde hair, and blue eyes smiles gently, her head tilted slightly. She wears a golden crown set with a large blue sapphire and smaller gems. Her long-sleeved dress is composed of a red tunic over a blue-grey undergarment, both accented with ornate gold trim at the neck and cuffs. A heavy gold belt made of large, circular medallions sits low on her waist. She holds an embossed golden goblet in her left hand and extends her right hand outwards, palm up. She stands before a deep red, textured background featuring the faint, embossed outline of a world map. The scene is warmly lit from the front, highlighting her features and golden adornments.
A red-haired woman in a pearl-studded brown and cream gown and a tall crown stands before a painted castle and fountain.

A fair-skinned woman with reddish-orange hair styled in tight curls piled high on her head, topped with a complex gold crown featuring dark blue heart shapes and pearls. She looks toward the viewer with a slight smile. She wears an elaborate gown with a high, white, frilled collar. The dress has puffy, dark brown sleeves with cream-colored fabric showing through slits, all studded with pearls. Her low-cut bodice is adorned with a pearl necklace and a jeweled gold pendant. She holds a small, dark object in her raised left hand. The background is a softly painted scene of a large, pale stone manor with many windows, set against a blue sky. In front of the manor is a green lawn with a large, two-tiered stone fountain. The lighting on the woman is bright and clear, contrasting with the softer lighting of the painted background.
A bald man with a white mustache and round glasses smiles gently, holding a wooden staff against a brown, map-like background.

A stylized portrait of a slender, older man with dark brown skin. He is bald on top with a fringe of short, white hair around the sides and back of his head. He has a neat, white mustache, and his dark eyes look forward through small, round, gold-rimmed spectacles. A gentle smile creases his face. The man is bare-chested, with a simple, off-white cloth draped over his left shoulder and across his torso; another piece of the same cloth is wrapped around his waist. He stands facing forward, holding a rough-hewn wooden staff in his right hand. His left hand is slightly raised, with fingers curled as if in the middle of a gesture. The background is a textured, sepia-toned surface with the faint, embossed outlines of a world map. The overall color palette consists of warm browns and tans. The figure is lit from the front, highlighting his features and casting soft shadows that define his lean musculature.
A man in a furry hat and studded leather armor smiles with his hands on his hips before a world map.

A man with a medium complexion, a round face, dark eyes, and raised eyebrows smiles slightly. He has a thin black mustache and a goatee. He wears a large, round, furry brown hat with a studded leather band across his forehead. His armor consists of a studded brown leather gorget over his shoulders, decorated with white triangular pieces and a central black metal disc. Below this is a brown leather cuirass reinforced with rectangular metal plates. A dark, long-sleeved garment is visible underneath. He wears matching leather bracers on his forearms and dark brown gloves. A wide belt with a large, round metal buckle is at his waist. He stands from the waist up with his hands placed firmly on his hips. He is positioned in front of a large, brown, textured background showing the outlines of a world map. The color palette is warm and monochromatic, dominated by shades of brown, with soft frontal lighting that illuminates the figure.
A muscular man with a thick black beard and a smiling expression wears a red and gold headdress, a blue tunic, and golden armguards.

A very muscular man with medium-tan skin and a broad, smiling face looks directly at the viewer. He has a thick, well-groomed black beard and mustache that covers the lower half of his face, and his smile reveals his upper teeth. He wears a red and gold patterned headdress with a golden circlet around his brow. Around his neck and across his broad chest is a heavy necklace composed of large, circular gold medallions; the central medallion features a lion's head in relief. His clothing consists of a short-sleeved, vertically striped teal tunic with a decorative border of red and white circles. A wide red sash is tied around his waist. He wears ornate, embossed gold armguards and part of a pauldron. He stands with his right hand on his hip, his body turned slightly away. The background is a textured, brownish-gold surface with a faint, antique-style line drawing of a world map. The lighting is warm and direct, creating bright highlights on the gold.
A tan-skinned woman with dark hair and a gold headdress smiles gently, a white plumeria flower tucked behind her left ear.

The portrait shows a tan-skinned woman from the chest up, her head slightly tilted. She has dark brown hair, dark eyebrows, and dark, winged eyeliner extending from her dark eyes, which gaze slightly upward and to the right. A gentle, closed-mouth smile plays on her lips. She wears an elaborate, tall gold headdress, intricately designed with patterns and possibly embedded with small red jewels, covering the top and sides of her head. A white plumeria flower with a yellow center is tucked into her dark hair, visible just behind her left ear. Gold earrings with blue accents hang from her ears. Below her neck, a dark garment with gold trim is visible. The figure is set against a dark, abstract circular background, which appears to have a subtle textured pattern. The lighting is soft and frontal, illuminating her face and the metallic gleam of her headdress and jewelry.
A woman in a red, one-shouldered garment holds a golden spear against a red world map background.

A woman with olive-toned skin and dark eyes looks directly forward with a slight smile. Her dark brown hair is styled in an updo, pulled away from her face. She wears a sleeveless, one-shouldered garment of dark red, draped fabric. The shoulder strap is trimmed with a gold band featuring a leaf pattern and is fastened with a gold clasp. A wide brown belt with a large clasp of interlocking dark metal rings cinches the garment at her waist. Below this belt, two thin gold ropes are draped across her hips. Her jewelry includes large, thick gold hoop earrings and a wide, patterned gold armband on her left bicep. She stands turned slightly, holding a tall wooden spear with an ornate, leaf-shaped golden head in her left hand. The background is a textured, deep red surface with a faint, dark outline of a world map. The color palette is dominated by reds, browns, and golds, with light coming from the front and left, illuminating the woman and her spear while the bottom of the portrait fades to black.
A man with a thick, dark, braided beard and a flat-topped golden headdress looks forward with an intense expression.

A man with medium-dark skin and a fixed, forward gaze is shown from the chest up. His thick, dark eyebrows are drawn together over wide, dark eyes. He wears a large, dark mustache that curls at the ends, merging into a very thick, full beard that extends to his chest, styled in tight, horizontal braids. On his head is a large, cylindrical, flat-topped golden headdress decorated with a band of blue and white squares. He wears large gold earrings with turquoise beads and a twisted gold bracelet on his wrist. His white tunic has golden diamond patterns on the sleeves. A wide blue sash with a thick, golden corded fringe is draped over his left shoulder, featuring a teal panel across his chest with three golden sunburst medallions. The background is a dark blue surface with the faint outline of a world map. The lighting is bright from the front, casting strong shadows and highlighting his face and golden adornments.
A bearded man in a pointed helmet and lamellar armor stands with a clenched fist before several longships on a choppy sea.

A light-skinned man with blue eyes and a thick brown beard and mustache looks directly forward. He wears a dark metal conical helmet with a gold spike and a decorative gold band with an interlocking pattern. His armor consists of a chainmail coif, dark rectangular plates of lamellar armor over his torso, and layered shoulder guards trimmed in gold. A wide leather strap with gold studs crosses his chest. He stands with his right hand clenched into a fist at his side. The background is a painterly scene of several dark wood longships with carved prows on a choppy sea, docked in a fjord with steep, dark mountains in the distance. The sky is a dusky blue, with a small, bright moon low on the horizon. The man is clearly lit from the front, while the background scene is darker and more atmospheric.
A smiling, bearded man in a masked bronze helmet and scale armor stands before a dark world map.

A fair-skinned man with long brown hair and a full beard smiles, showing his upper teeth. He wears an ornate bronze helmet with a green crest and a decorative faceplate covering his eyes. A red cape with a light-colored fur collar is draped over his right shoulder, fastened by a large, circular gold brooch. Beneath it, he wears a purple tunic and a brown leather cuirass made of small, overlapping riveted scales. A wide leather belt with a gold buckle is cinched at his waist, and a strapped leather bracer covers his right forearm. He stands angled to his left with his right hand clenched in a fist at his hip. The background is a dark, teal-blue, stylized map of the world. The lighting comes from the upper left, highlighting the figure against the dark backdrop.
A man in a blue tunic and black cap stands holding a sheathed sword with both hands.

A man with light skin, dark eyes, and high cheekbones is shown from the thighs up. He wears a tall, black, folded cap. His primary garment is a loose-fitting, hip-length tunic of bright blue, decorated with a subtle, lighter blue floral pattern and a white triangle on each shoulder. A thick, reddish-brown cord with tassels is tied in a decorative knot at his chest. Under this, an olive-green robe is visible at his neck and sleeves. He wears voluminous dark trousers. On his left forearm is a black metal arm guard over a red sleeve. The man stands angled slightly, holding a sheathed sword horizontally before him with both hands. His left hand is near the hilt, his right holds the scabbard, and a white cloth is draped over it. The background is a dark, textured blue wall with a faint, embossed map of the world. The scene is lit from the front, casting the man in a clear light against the dim background.
A smiling woman in a gold crown and a half-red, half-purple dress holds a golden scepter.

A woman with fair skin, brown hair to her shoulders, and brown eyes looks forward with a slight, closed-mouth smile. She wears an ornate gold crown set with rectangular purple gems. A necklace of large, off-white beads rests above a wide gold collar decorated with turquoise stones. Her long-sleeved gown is vertically divided; her right side is a textured, deep red, and her left is purple with a repeating light-purple fleur-de-lis pattern. A golden, double-headed eagle emblem is fixed to the center of her chest. She holds a tall golden scepter topped with a stylized lotus flower in her right hand, while her left hand is held open at her side. The figure is brightly lit from the front and stands against a plain white background.
A bald, dark-skinned man with a gentle smile, wearing a thick gold coiled necklace and small gold and black earrings, against a dark green background.

The portrait shows a bald, dark-skinned man from the chest up, positioned against a dark, circular background featuring a mottled green and black, abstract pattern. He has a round face with a broad nose and full lips, and his dark eyes look slightly to the viewer's right, accompanied by a gentle, closed-mouth smile. Small, dark eyebrows are visible above his eyes. Around his neck is a thick, multi-coiled golden necklace that rests over the visible top of a red and white garment. Both of his ears are adorned with small, cylindrical earrings that are gold with black bands. Soft, frontal lighting illuminates his features and the gold of his ornaments, creating a warm overall palette against the dark background.
A stone statue of a bearded man in a heavy overcoat stands with a hand on his hip against a bright blue sky.

A full-length statue of a man, carved from light-colored stone, is depicted from a low angle. The man has a short, trimmed beard and wears a flat, round cap. He is dressed in a heavy, knee-length overcoat with wide lapels and voluminous sleeves, worn over a pleated tunic. A sash is tied at his waist, holding a dagger with an ornate hilt. A cross is visible on his chest. He stands with his right hand on his hip and his left hand resting on the stone block beside him. The background is a bright blue sky with a few wispy white clouds. In the lower-left corner, a portion of a white building with a tiled roof is visible. The scene is bathed in bright, direct sunlight, creating strong contrasts and shadows on the statue.
A smiling man in a brown hat and round glasses wears a waistcoat and a red tie.

A man with tanned skin, dark hair, and green eyes looks forward with a slight smile. He wears small, round, gold-rimmed spectacles. On his head is a light brown hat with a pinched crown and a dark brown band. He is dressed in a light blue and white vertically striped collared shirt, a red silk tie, and a dark brown, textured waistcoat. A thin gold chain drapes from a buttonhole into a pocket on the waistcoat. He is shown from the waist up against a neutral background, with his body angled slightly to his right and his arms at his sides. The lighting is bright and even.
A full-length, off-white marble statue of a man in Roman military armor, wearing a laurel wreath and holding a baton.

This is a full-length statue of a man, carved from off-white marble. He has a stern expression with a square jaw, thin lips, and his gaze is directed up and to his left. His short hair is crowned with a detailed laurel wreath. He wears ornate Roman military attire, including a cuirass with swirling patterns over a tunic, and a heavy cloak draped over his left shoulder and around his waist. On his legs are breeches and strapped sandals. The figure stands in a dynamic pose, turning to his left. His right arm is extended, holding a short baton, while his left hand rests on a rectangular, quilted object at his side. The statue is set against a plain white background, with lighting from the upper left creating strong shadows that emphasize the details of the carving.
A woman with voluminous brown hair in a dark, high-collared jacket holds a large, leather-bound book against a backdrop of a world map.

A fair-skinned woman with green eyes and prominent, arched eyebrows looks directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. Her thick, brown hair is styled in large, shoulder-length curls that frame her face. She wears a dark grey, high-collared jacket with padded shoulders and a flared waist, fastened with a row of gold buttons. The long sleeves are adorned with matching buttons and end in wide, white lace cuffs detailed with black embroidery. She holds a large, brown leather-bound book with both hands; the book is reinforced with gold-colored metal corners. The background is a textured, dark blue wall featuring a faintly embossed, stylized map of the world. The overall color palette is muted, with dark greys, browns, and blues, accented by the white lace and gold buttons. A soft light from the front illuminates the woman, setting her apart from the dim background.
A man with gray hair, a long mustache, and a pointed beard wears a cream and gold robe, his arms crossed with hands clasped.

A middle-aged man with light brown skin and dark eyes is shown from the waist up. His dark gray hair is combed back, and he has a long, drooping gray mustache and a pointed gray goatee that extends to his chest. He wears a high-collared robe of cream-colored, patterned silk, with wide, shiny gold trim on the collar and cuffs. A wide red belt with a large, ornate silver buckle is visible at his waist.
